chunks: It was He who restrained their hands from you, and your hands from them, in the valley of Makkah, after He had given you victory over them, and God is Seeing of what you do.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'restrained their hands from you' refer to in Surah Al-Fath?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Habs al-Yadayn' (restraining the hands), illustrating how divine providence maintained peace during the Truce of Hudaybiyyah to allow the spread of Islam. It underscores the strategic wisdom of Allah in granting victory not just through battle, but through the cessation of hostilities, reinforcing the theme of divine omniscience over human deeds.
